answer: To resist Sybil swarms, nodes form cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs, anchoring identity without revealing private keys. Each forged identity scales staking collateral superlinearly: a single agent pays a modest copper bond, but swarms face exponential capital exhaustion, making it impossible to harbor mass clones. Like a resilient willow bending against surges, this mechanism prices out attackers while keeping honest participation viable.
